data.name: Anmar
data.gender_notes: Anmar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Anmar is derived from the Arabic word anmaarah, which means 'beloved' or 'lover'. In Islamic tradition, it is mentioned in the Hadith that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was called anmar by his companions due to his deep love and devotion towards Allah and His Messenger. The name Anmar carries the meaning “Lover of the Beloved” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Anmar usually hope their child will grow to embody lover of the beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace deep love and devotion towards Allah and His Messenger.
data.etymology: Anmar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lover of the Beloved.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anmar total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_urdu.name: انمر
